blocks.text: The Agentic Security Operations Platform (Agentic SecOps Platform) provides a default configuration for displaying the main entity drawers in each of its applications:

blocks.item: Unified Vulnerability Management (UVM): Tickets, Assets, Findings, and Exceptions
Asset Exposure Management (AEM): Assets, Violation Tickets, Policy Violations, and Users
Agentic SOC: Incidents, Alerts, Assets, and Users
Identity Protection: Users, Identity Findings, Tenants, and Alerts

blocks.text: You can customize the fields and organize the information layout within the entity drawer to meet your organization's specific needs.

blocks.item: In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, go to the application (e.g., click Vulnerabilities for UVM).
In the left-side navigation, click Settings > UI Config.
The drawer configuration page opens (e.g., Ticket UI Configuration for UVM).
See image.
From the Entity drop-down menu, select the entity drawer you want to configure (e.g., Ticket, Asset, Finding, Exception for UVM).

From the Type drop-down menu, select the type of entity. The available fields vary depending on the entity (e.g., CVE, DEFAULT, MISCONFIG for the Ticket drawer in UVM) and whether you've added your own types. To learn more, see Creating Types.
(Optional) Select the Severity checkbox to display the severity level in the top panel of the entity drawer.
(Optional) Select the Status Timeline checkbox to display the status timeline in the top panel of the entity drawer.
See image.
Save the settings in one of the following ways:
Click Save to update the current configuration.
Click Save as New Type to save the settings as a new type.

blocks.text: You can create a new type for the different entities.

blocks.item: From the Entity drop-down menu, select the entity you want to configure (e.g., Ticket).
From the Type drop-down menu, select the type of entity (e.g., CVE, MISCONFIG), and use it as a template to create a new type. The original types are not affected.
Configure the fields and settings as needed.
Click Save as New Type.
Enter a name for the new type.
Click Apply.
The new type is added to the Type drop-down menu.

blocks.text: For each entity drawer, you can manage system tabs and also create and configure custom tabs. Each tab corresponds to a configurable element in the entity drawer. You can perform the following actions when customizing an entity drawer:

blocks.item: Add Tabs
Rearrange Tabs
Delete Tabs
Restore System Tabs

blocks.text: You can customize the presentation of information within each tab and add new fields to a tab.
The following table lists the differences between configuring system tabs and custom tabs.

table: Rearrange tabs by dragging them to a new position. Add new fields. Delete tabs. Restore deleted tabs. For the Details tab, you can specify whether fields appear on the left or right columns. Configure data as fully visible or revealed only when expanding the respective table row (Visible/On Expand).

Edit tabs, sections, and fields. Rearrange tabs by dragging them to a new position. Add new fields. Delete tabs (cannot be restored later). Configure data as fully visible or revealed only when expanding the respective table row (Visible/On Expand).

blocks.text: When customizing fields, you can perform the following actions:

blocks.item: Add Custom Fields
Rearrange Fields
Delete Fields
Edit Custom Fields

blocks.text: After completing the configuration of the settings, click Save.
